justification: Heritage styling + three diagnosis-driven reliability fixes from a live Haberfield brief. (1) HERITAGE STYLING: heritage_items/heritage_hca are list[str] like '<name> Significance: <level>' but rendered as a comma run-on; added a HeritageList component — one item per line, significance as a small badge. (2) SHADOW 'Unavailable': the brief collected shadow with a 50s budget but the shadow endpoint's own POST timeout is 60s, so the brief cut it off 10s early; raised timeout_shadow_collect 50->65s. (3) FLOOD blanks (JRC/WOfS/EPI '—'): these concurrent sub-queries timed out internally (EPI 20s, JRC 25s, WOfS 25s) and returned None (a genuine no-water reading returns 0.0, so the blank means timeout/no-data, not a real zero); raised them to 30/35/35s — still under the 50s flood budget since they run concurrently — so they can return the true value. (4) PRE-DA 'didn't finish in time' was misleading: the brief finished in 96s with a 120s pre-DA budget, so pre-DA ERRORED fast (not a timeout); the frontend now distinguishes a real timeout from a fast error and surfaces the actual backend reason instead of pretending it timed out.

pre_impl.existing_data: heritage_items/heritage_hca are DataField[list[str]]; the flood sub-queries already return None on failure and a real float (incl 0.0) on success; the shadow endpoint POST already used timeout=60.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: A blank flood field looked like 'no data' but actually means the remote sub-query timed out (a genuine zero would render '0'); pre-DA 'didn't finish in time' implied a timeout but it errors fast.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reused the existing list-field render pattern (like OverlayList) for heritage; bumped existing timeout constants; reused the existing reason string for pre-DA.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Slow EPI/JRC/WOfS remote servers now get more time; a still-failing sub-query stays None (honest blank). Shadow endpoint failures still surface NOT_AVAILABLE.
pre_impl.frontend_type: Frontend (heritage render + pre-DA message) + backend timeout constants. tsc passes.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: heritage as an unreadable run-on; flood blanks ambiguous; shadow cut off early; pre-DA blaming a timeout it didn't hit. After: heritage as a clean list with significance badges; flood sub-queries get time to return real values; shadow waits past the endpoint's own limit; pre-DA shows the real reason.

functions.name: HeritageList
functions.input: a list of heritage item strings each ending in ' Significance: <level>'
functions.output: a stacked list with the name and a significance badge per item
functions.if_none: an empty list renders a plain 'No heritage listing recorded' line

functions.name: describeUnavailable
functions.input: the field reason, section, and whether satellite ran
functions.output: for pre-DA, a 'not requested' / genuine-timeout / fast-error message that surfaces the real backend reason
functions.if_none: falls through to the generic unavailable handling

values: N/A - heritage strings and timeout constants, not regulatory values.
queries: N/A - no DB query changed; only HTTP sub-query timeouts in flood_truth (EPI/JRC/WOfS) bumped.

break_it.scenario: A heritage item string has no ' Significance:' delimiter
break_it.what_happens: the item could render without its significance badge separated out
break_it.repro: an item that is just a name
break_it.how: the regex falls back to showing the whole string as the name with no badge

break_it.scenario: Flood sub-queries still time out at the higher 35s and the brief's 50s budget is exceeded
break_it.what_happens: the flood section could be cut off
break_it.repro: all three remote servers stall past 35s
break_it.how: the sub-queries run concurrently (ThreadPoolExecutor), so the flood endpoint completes at max(sub-query) ~= 35s, under the 50s brief budget

break_it.scenario: Shadow still fails fast because the lot-geometry fetch 422s (not a timeout)
break_it.what_happens: raising the budget to 65s would not help
break_it.repro: a parcel with no Portal geometry
break_it.how: the 65s budget fixes the timeout case; a genuine geometry failure still surfaces an honest 'Unavailable' — no false data either way

break_it.scenario: Pre-DA reason leaks an ugly backend exception to a real user
break_it.what_happens: a raw error string could show
break_it.repro: pre-DA errors with a verbose message
break_it.how: the reason is capped at 160 chars and framed as 'a backend issue, not your input'; this is a dev/demo tool and the visible reason is what lets the cause be diagnosed

post_merge.manual_verify: Re-run the Haberfield brief: Heritage Items/HCA render as a clean list with significance badges; flood JRC/WOfS show real values (or honest blanks) instead of timing out; shadow gets 65s; if pre-DA still fails it now shows the real reason.
